caption:
A diaspora group's first DC-area gala raised $214,000 for disabled Indians in one night.

VOSAP (Voice of Specially Abled People) held its first-ever Washington D.C. metro-area fundraiser in March 2026 - a sold-out Fairfax, Virginia gala with 160 attendees. Donors gave $107,000, matched dollar for dollar by a chief patron couple, funding India's Assistive Technology Program and Project HITARTH for healthcare access for people with intellectual disabilities. VOSAP's 2026 goal: reach 100,000 people with disabilities across India.

One night, one gala, 160 people in a room in Virginia. A hundred thousand people in India are the reason they showed up.

Sources: VOSAP, IANS
